single_factor: Head state transition replaced by signed normalized linear EMA without firing/reset
operation_order: multiply previous state by lambda; multiply current by 1-lambda; add; compute signed tail loss; add one-time prototype bias; class-wise max then foreground-minus-background
stem_hidden: Unchanged continuous charge, thresholds, time constants and detached reset gradients
gradient: Exact linear gradient for the new head; no compensating learning-rate/weight rescaling; unchanged stem/hidden surrogate reset gradient
regularizer: Unchanged mean squared positive/negative head peak excess above16, weight0.1, now evaluated on the new z state; unchanged stem/hidden activity regularizer
guards: Unchanged positive-part amplitude/threshold<=256, absolute signed voltage/threshold<=4096 for all layers, loss<=100 and gradient norm<=10000; |logit|>80 advisory only
guard_note: The head has no activation/firing. relu(z/theta) is a monitor-only positive-amplitude proxy. Signed head min/max and absolute voltage are always reported. No original guard is removed or weakened.
cost: Same dense synaptic MAC; count 128 extra current-normalization multiplications per executed grid cell-step separately; no AC or energy claim
data: Train-main fitting and stress checks; Train-dev selection; reserved splits unopened
budget: One fresh seed42 epoch, explicitly authorized; no automatic continuation
